name: ant-farm
description: Prototype: tend your Claude Managed Agents from Claude Code through the ant CLI. A fleet bar and mission control, live session TV, @agent asks, dispatch to the cloud, an approval inbox, ant apply plans, a schedule board, a flight recorder, bake-offs and the farm itself.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Show the fleet bar and serve the ant-farm commands and tools.

antPath.title: ant CLI
antPath.description: The ant executable to run. It uses whatever profile `ant auth status` shows.

pollSeconds.title: Refresh every (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often the fleet (agents, sessions, deployments) is re-read.

defaultEnvironment.title: Default environment
defaultEnvironment.description: The environment id a new session runs in when its agent has never run before. Empty means none.

sessionBudget.title: Session budget (USD)
sessionBudget.description: The spend cap put on every session started from here (asks, dispatches, bake-offs).
